requiredToProceed: Provide a non-fixture, non-media ratings submission in an approved private study workspace or explicit repository-safe CSV/JSON path.
Ensure every row references an accepted pseudonymous participant ID from a completed participant intake.
Ensure every selected option and recommendation rank references a verified production catalog record from the tested catalog version.
Include deletion confirmation for each completed participant result.
Keep raw face media and identifying details out of Git.
